subject: AWS co-sell — Kestrel Health: demo, intake & joint roadmap
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@kestrelhealth.com>, Nate Alvarez <nate_alvarez@amazon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell — Kestrel Health: demo, intake & joint roadmap

Hi Alicia, Nate,

Great to meet you over email — I'm Markus on Redwood's GTM team. Kestrel's usage scenario (inference at the point of care) sounds like a strong fit for an AWS co-sell. We'd love to coordinate a short discovery/demo and put together a mutual action plan so AWS, Kestrel, and Redwood have clear next steps.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- 30-min customer demo (we'll show latency/cost profile for clinical inference)
- Draft mutual action plan (procurement touchpoints, pilot metrics, success criteria)
- Share security contact and SOC2 evidence request flow

Laura and Karthik — looping you in to help with the MA plan and technical prep. Alicia — what days/times next week look best for a quick demo? Also, are there procurement or legal timelines we should be aware of?

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none (will follow with MA plan draft)

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Nate Alvarez <nate_alvarez@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell — Kestrel Health: demo, intake & joint roadmap

Hi Markus (and team),

Thanks — excited to connect. We're available for a 30-min demo on Tuesday 8/25 between 10–12 ET or Thursday 8/27 after 2 PM ET. The main folks who should join from Kestrel: Ben Turner (POC), myself, and our security lead (I copied security@kestrelhealth.com).

A few housekeeping notes:
- Procurement is targeting a Q4 pilot contract; tentative budget is set but needs approval.
- Security will need a SOC2 and data flow diagram; can you share how Redwood handles inference data (prefix caching, retention by default)?

If you have an MA plan draft, please attach — we can review ahead of the demo.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Platform Partnerships, Kestrel Health
alicia.ramos@kestrelhealth.com

Markus / Laura,

Thanks — Alicia's times are doable. I'm drafting a short mutual action plan (matrix-style) that outlines owner, due date, and acceptance criteria. I'll attach v1 here for your review. Key items I'm including:
- Pilot scope & success metrics (latency p95, tokens per request, error rate)
- Trial instance config & cost estimate (Dedicated vs hosted burst)
- Security evidence required (SOC2 report, data flow, encryption details)
- AWS handoff (partner rep tasks + co-sell ask)

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_kestrel_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Two quick asks before demo:
1) Markus — can we get the HubSpot deal ID so we can log the MA plan against the opportunity?
2) Laura — can you prepare a one-pager focused on clinical latency benchmarks?

I'll send an updated file after your feedback.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

1) 5 min intros & objectives (Kestrel/AWS/Redwood)
2) 12 min demo: clinical inference flow + latency/cost slides (Laura)
3) 8 min MA plan review & timeline (Karthik)
4) 5 min next steps & action owners

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (deal RDW-KEST-2026-042)

Alicia / Ben — please confirm that the time works and that security can join for the tail end of the call (or a follow-up). Nate (AWS) — can you confirm whether AWS will join with any ask for positioning on the pilot?

See you Thursday,

Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Thanks Mark, Karthik, Laura — meeting works for us. Quick notes ahead of Thursday:

- Security will join for the last 10 minutes; they'll want the SOC2 link and a brief data flow diagram. Alicia, I'll forward our security questions as well.
- Procurement note: our legal lead wants to see standard reseller terms and whether Redwood supports a DPA (we will need one).
- For pilot sizing, can you include a short cost delta table for hosted API vs dedicated pool? Even ballpark numbers help our procurement committee.

Looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Ben Turner
Senior Product Manager, Integrations, Kestrel Health
ben.turner@kestrelhealth.com
